author: AnarchyCore
quote:
GTA V is better than GTA VI.

Sure, the graphics are obviously better, but that's literally the only thing this game has going for it. Everything else feels like a massive downgrade. Boring gameplay, boring story, boring characters. What the actual **** happened to Rockstar?

This feels less like a GTA game and more like a cuck simulator with a billion-dollar graphics budget. Absolutely **** trash. I genuinely don't understand how they managed to make a game this boring after GTA V.

GTA V, despite being over a decade old, is still miles better and more entertaining than this garbage.

Graphics: 10/10. Everything else: **** disappointing.
